Column Name: Summary Comparison: Seed Data vs. Synthetic Data

The synthetic codebook closely preserves the sample size (N=5210), missing data proportions, and distributional moments (Means & SDs) of the original seed dataset while introducing structural enhancements necessary for statistical modeling.
Cohort Size: Maintained at exactly N=5210.
Outcome Variable (synthetic_asd_flag): Replaces the explicit population groups with a binary variable (1=AutismGroup,0=Control).
The synthetic mean of 0.39 corresponds to $\sim 39.1\%$ prevalence, matching the seed ratio ($\frac{2039}{5210} = 39.14\%$).
Continuous variables retain their mean, variance, realistic minimum/maximum limits, and missing rates:
dr_gawks (Gestational Age): Seed mean = 38.4, SD = 2.5, Missing = $1.1\%$  Synthetic mean = 38.42, SD = 2.52, Missing = $1.09\%$.
dr_agebir_mx (Maternal Age): Seed mean = 30.9, SD = 5.6, Missing $<0.1\%$  Synthetic mean = 30.91, SD = 5.61, Missing $<0.21\%$.
dr_agebir_fx (Paternal Age): Seed mean = 33.5, SD = 6.5, Missing = $3.3\%$  Synthetic mean = 33.38, SD = 6.38, Missing = $3.28\%$.
DR_pgsASD_CX (ASD Polygenic Risk Score): Seed mean = 0.10, SD = 1.0, Missing = $59.1\%$  Synthetic mean = 0.05, SD = 1.00, Missing = $59.08\%$.
The synthetic codebook converts text categories and binary status flags into numerical formats (float64 / int64):
dr_dep_mmh_mx: Mean 0.25 ($\sim 25\%$ positive rate), Nulls: 757 nulls ($14.53\%$).
dr_prevlb_br_3c: Encoded 1–3 (First born to 3rd+). Weighted mean = 1.74.
dr_biredu_mx_5c: Encoded 1–5 (Less than HS to Advanced Degree). Weighted mean = 3.62.
dr_race_mx_5c: Recoded into integer levels 1–5 (Mean = 1.86, indicating level 1 represents White non-Hispanic).
